**Hungry for a challenge?**
---------------------------

  

That’s good, because at Just Eat Takeaway.com (JET) we believe everything is possible, or, as we say, everything is on the table. We are a leading global online food delivery marketplace. Our tech ecosystem connects millions of active customers with hundreds of thousands of connected partners in countries across the globe.

  

Our mission? To empower every food moment around the world, whether it’s through customer service, coding, or couriers.

**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

  

We are looking for a proactive software engineer with a strong backend foundation and full\-stack capabilities to join our Identity \& Access Management (AuthN/AuthZ) team. As a Full\-Stack Engineer, you will bring solid experience in security architectures, identity systems, and distributed microservices to the table.

  

In this role, you will be instrumental in building high\-throughput authorization services, extending enterprise authentication workflows, maintaining developer SDKs, and delivering intuitive frontend interfaces for our global ecosystem.

 **In this role you'll have the responsibility to:**

  

* **Build \& Scale Identity Services:** Design, develop, and maintain enterprise Authentication infrastructure built primarily on **Java and Keycloak**, alongside high\-concurrency Authorization microservices in **Go** and **Kotlin**.
* **Deliver End\-to\-End Features (React):** Build clean, secure, and responsive frontend applications and admin dashboards using **React** to support seamlessly integrated user and partner identity journeys.
* **Support Polyglot Ecosystems \& Tooling:** Support client\-side **.NET SDKs** and write **Python** automation scripts to streamline developer onboarding, authorization checks, and ops automation across JET teams.
* **Drive Cloud Infrastructure \& Reliability:** Package, deploy, and scale microservices using **Docker**, **Kubernetes (k8s)**, and **AWS**, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and tight security controls.
* **Elevate Technical Standards:** Implement modern security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, RBAC/ABAC), adhere to observability standards, and actively participate in collaborative architectural reviews and team knowledge sharing.

**What Will You Bring to the Table?**
-------------------------------------

* **Solid Java Backend Experience:** Commercial experience in backend engineering, with a strong primary focus on **Java**, and comfort working in a polyglot environment (Go, Kotlin).
* **Domain Knowledge in AuthN \& AuthZ:** Hands\-on experience with identity protocols (OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML) and custom/open\-source identity providers such as **Keycloak**.
* **Frontend Capabilities:** Nice to have hands\-on proficiency or willing to work with **React** (JavaScript/TypeScript) to deliver modern, end\-to\-end full\-stack solutions.
* **Cloud \& Container Experience:** Experience operating services in production with **Kubernetes (k8s)**, **Docker**, and **AWS cloud services**.
* **SDK \& Scripting Versatility:** Familiarity or comfort working with **.NET** (for internal client SDK maintenance) and **Python** (for automation and tooling).
* **AI\-Assisted Development \& SRE Mindset:** Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development, paired with an operational mindset focused on monitoring and reliability.

 **At JET, This Is On The Menu**  

  

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best\-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.  

  

Fun, fast\-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition.  

  

**Inclusion, Diversity \& Belonging**  

  

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.  

  

**What else are we delivering?**  

  

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels.  

  

Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

*"Are you looking for an opportunity to drive commercial growth, own strategic client relationships, and shape the future of software compliance advisory at a global level?"*

 **About the Company**

  


Connor Consulting Partners, LLC is a specialist advisory firm delivering software license compliance and advisory services to a global client base.

  

We are in an exciting period of growth and organizational maturity. Our line of business is structured so that every person operates at their highest value: Directors focus on client outcomes and commercial growth, a dedicated delivery management function provides the operational infrastructure, and Account Managers and Technical Leads run day\-to\-day execution with genuine autonomy. The result is a firm where senior leaders spend their time on the work that matters most \- growing accounts and winning new business.

 **The Opportunity**

  


We are looking for a Director to take ownership of a portfolio of client accounts within our Software Publishers Services line of business. This is a senior commercial role: you will be accountable for the revenue, growth, and quality outcomes your clients experience.

  

This is not a delivery management role. We have a mature delivery infrastructure \- tracking systems, quality frameworks, structured escalation pathways, and a capable operations team \- that handles day\-to\-day execution. Your focus will be on the outcomes that matter: growing your accounts, winning new business, maintaining senior client relationships, and ensuring the quality standard your clients receive meets the firm's expectations.

  

The right person for this role is a commercially\-minded leader who has the confidence to step back from operational detail and trust a well\-designed delivery system, while retaining clear accountability for results.

  

This role also carries a strategic dimension beyond day\-to\-day portfolio management. The software publisher services landscape is evolving. Publishers are shifting from audit enforcement toward models built around customer engagement and customer success, and we are actively leading that evolution. Connor is at the front of this change, helping publishers and their customers move toward advisory\-led relationships that create lasting value on both sides. The Director we hire will help shape what that looks like in practice: driving the new services we take to market, influencing how publishers engage with their customers, and building the commercial credibility that positions Connor as the firm that leads with advisory, not audit.  **Commercial Ownership**

* Drive account\-level growth and revenue extraction from existing contracts. Identify and convert upsell and cross\-sell opportunities.
* Pursue net\-new client acquisition through your professional network and market presence. A significant portion of your time should be directed toward new business development.
* Consult the delivery management function on capacity before finalizing commercial commitments. You retain full authority to commit, and you own the delivery risk associated with your decisions.

* Build and deepen the relationships that generate long\-term account value. Your Account Managers handle the day\-to\-day; you hold the strategic relationship.

* Ultimately accountable for the quality standard your clients experience. The delivery function provides quality frameworks, checklists, and tracking; you are accountable for the results those systems produce.
* Hold your delivery teams accountable for the quality of every deliverable. When quality issues arise, you set the standard for what constitutes an acceptable resolution.

* Champion and reinforce the firm's delivery standards within your accounts. Consistent quality is a business standard that depends on leadership at every level.

* Retain final say on staffing decisions for your accounts. The delivery function assesses capability and recommends; you make the call.

* Use your client relationships as a proving ground for advisory\-led engagements. Test new service lines, identify what resonates commercially, and feed those insights back into the firm’s go\-to\-market strategy.

* Contribute to the firm's market positioning and thought leadership in software compliance and advisory.

* Consult on delivery capacity before making commitments to clients. This is not about seeking permission \- it is about making informed decisions with the full picture.

Revenue, growth, client relationships, quality outcomes, strategic decisions

 **Not your focus**

**Qualifications**

 **What We Offer**
